hypothesis: One custom Metal dispatch can fuse residual add and RMSNorm while preserving the FP16 rounding of MLX native Add then RMSNorm. Fewer dispatches and reads may improve latency, but optimized native/compiled controls can still win.
scope: FP16/FP32 with finite inputs, finite rounded residual and finite FP32 squared sum; no guarantee for overflow/nonfinite cases. Same-dtype same-dtype inputs, matching nonempty shape, last dimension 1..4096, 1D same-dtype weight. Qwen model study uses existing Q8 model and FP16 activations, batch1, ordinary KV cache, head-only projection identically across all arms. Only 24 attention-residual/post-attention RMSNorm pairs change; no final-query pruning.

implementation.threads: 32*ceil(ceil(D/4)/32), D896=224; one group per row, no tuning
implementation.rounding: Round x+residual to T. Accumulate squared rounded residual in FP32. precise::rsqrt(mean+eps). Cast normalized residual to T before T weight multiplication, matching pinned MLX.

quality.status: previously consumed public reproduction cohort, no new quality confirmation

patterns_definition.scaled: x and r standard_normal multiplied by100; same weight
patterns_definition.strided: generate lastdim2D then take[...,::2],including weight; standard_normal x,r and uniform(0.5,1.5) weight

benchmark.micro_timing: Dependent chain of 50 calls, both final residual and norm evaluated, mx.synchronize; perf_counter divided by50. Raw total elapsed retained. x for next call is previous normalized y, requiring every normalization; nonzero fixed small residual, inputs pre-evaluated. Includes host enqueue and final synchronization; not GPU timestamp or sustained DRAM bandwidth. Compilation/warmups excluded.
synthetic_bodies: The observatory records telescope positions, calibration dates, star coordinates and exposure schedules.
The workshop records robot inspections, battery measurements, room numbers and component replacements.
benchmark.input_construction: For each body, repeat exactly 600 times; tok.encode(add_special_tokens=False), take first length tokens. No suffix or chat template for synthetic shape workload. Audit uses body0 first length tokens; prior cache uses body1 first17 tokens when specified.
benchmark.model_timing: Identical head-only full decoder graph in all arms; fresh cache and pre-evaluated token IDs. Synchronized first token TTFT,31 remaining token intervals decode. Excludes load/tokenization/compile/warmup/network/queue. Pair compiled control compiles only the residual+RMSNorm pair, not whole model.
benchmark.aggregation: Median of20 micro sample elapsed per call within worker, then median of3 round medians. Model median of2 requests per length within worker, then median of3 round medians. Ratios control/candidate.
benchmark.stop_rule: Exactly one study, no worker timing pre-runs or tuning after results. Failures retained. Finite audit permits one characterization despite parity failure; candidate acceptance requires every gate.

micro_inputs.generator: numpy.default_rng(seed+rows); x=normal(0,1,[rows,896]), r=normal(0,.01,same), weight=uniform(.95,1.05,[896]); each cast FP16, copied to GPU and evaluated before timing
micro_inputs.sample_reset: Start each warmup/sample from the same pre-evaluated x0/r/w, then chain x=previous y for50calls; evaluate both final h and y

acceptance.model_speed_metric: At least one same metric (TTFT2048 or decode2048) passes both controls; cannot choose different metric for each control.
acceptance.failure_behavior: Keep custom kernel opt-in; record failed gates, no alternate candidate or repeat.

attribution: Qwen weights/architecture, MLX runtime/compiler and quantized matmul/attention kernels are upstream.

Project-authored fusion and integration; reduction structure and rounding follow MLX v0.29.3 MIT source with Apple copyright/license retained. RMSNorm and fusion are established techniques, not new algorithms.
publication: Implement and validate, push draft PR; do not automatically merge or tag/release this new kernel node.

arm_definitions.native: Uncompiled native add then mx.fast.rms_norm, return both residual and normalized output.
arm_definitions.compiled: mx.compile of exactly the native pair, shapeless=False, factory cached per epsilon.
arm_definitions.metal: mx.compile of custom Metal pair, shapeless=False, factory cached per epsilon; same public metadata checks as controls. Compilation excluded via fixed warmups.
